name: Bipin Yadav
summary:
Results-driven System Administrator | IT Support Engineer | Cybersecurity Analyst with 5+ years of
experience in IT infrastructure management, network administration, and cybersecurity support across
academic and corporate environments. Skilled in Windows & Linux server administration, Active Directory
(AD DS), Office 365, VLAN configuration, firewalls (FortiGate), VPN, and endpoint security. Proven expertise
in vulnerability assessment (Nessus, OpenVAS), incident response support, and SIEM log monitoring.
Strong track record in backup & disaster recovery planning, patch management, and compliance
documentation (NAAC, accreditation audits). Adept at troubleshooting complex systems, managing IT assets,
and providing end-to-end technical support for 2000+ users. Committed to leveraging technology to enhance
infrastructure security, academic delivery, and business continuity.

work_experience.company: Ramanbyte Pvt. Ltd. / Pune Institute of Business Management
responsibilities: Delivered end-to-end IT support for a hybrid academic and corporate environment serving 500+ staff and 2000+ students. Architected and maintained secure campus infrastructure: VLAN design, FortiGate firewall rules, Cisco access points, and Wi-Fi segmentation. Integrated Azure AD with Office 365, implementing MFA, conditional access policies, and streamlining user lifecycle management. Conducted vulnerability scanning (Nessus, OpenVAS) and implemented endpoint security measures and automated patch management. Deployed and secured Redmine project management server with UFW, SSH hardening, and role-based access control. Led disaster recovery planning, regular backup validation (Veeam, native tools), and ITIL-compliant documentation practices. Acted as primary technical lead during high-impact audits, including online MBA accreditation, ensuring infrastructure readiness and stakeholder coordination. Collaborated with digital marketing and media teams on IT support for content creation, shared drives, Teams, and email systems. Managed vendor coordination, AMC renewals, IT procurement, and license audits across endpoints and cloud services. Developed and enforced IT SOPs, inventory controls, and knowledge base articles to streamline operations. Coordinated with marketing teams to schedule and post event highlights, BTS clips, and promotional content across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and YouTube. Monitored engagement metrics (likes, shares, comments) and provided insights to enhance content performance. Managed live streaming and AV/VC setups for high-profile events including MSME, and VIP ministerial visits, ensuring flawless execution and audience engagement.
Delivered Tier-1 IT support for 150+ endpoints covering Windows OS, LAN/Wi-Fi,

printing, and application issues in a distributed field service environment. Performed software installation and configuration, including antivirus (Quick Heal, Windows Defender), VPN setup (FortiClient/OpenVPN), and basic patching tasks. Maintained and tracked IT hardware (laptops, routers, cables) using manual inventory logs; issued replacement tickets and updated records regularly. Escalated unresolved L2 issues to senior engineers with root cause analysis reports and interim fixes. Led weekly awareness sessions for end-users covering topics such as phishing, password hygiene, safe USB usage, and secure browsing. Provided IT support during service center visits, field meetings, and coordination calls between branches.
